payload.title: Fake CBI Digital Arrest Video Notice Portal
payload.description: Fraudulent portal displaying forged Supreme Court & CBI summons. Scammers on Skype/WhatsApp compel victims to transfer funds into "RBI asset verification escrow".
payload.sampleTemplate: URGENT NOTICE: CBI Case #AR-9812 registered against your Aadhaar. Connect Skype within 15 min or face immediate Digital Arrest. Check warrant: {{url}}

payload.title: Delhi Police Narcotics Department Spoofed Clearance Page
payload.description: Fake clearance certificate generator used during WhatsApp video calls where scammers dress in police uniform and demand money for drug parcel clearance.
payload.sampleTemplate: FedEx Customs Parcel containing illicit contraband intercepted under your name. Clearance fine required: {{url}}

payload.title: Mumbai Cyber Cell Marathi Video Summon Template
payload.description: Extortion notice sent to senior citizens in Maharashtra claiming their SIM card was used for terror financing, demanding instant Skype presence.
payload.sampleTemplate: तात्काळ सूचना: आपल्या आधार कार्डवर मनी लाँडरिंगचा गुन्हा दाखल झाला आहे. अटक टाळण्यासाठी त्वरित संपर्क करा.

payload.title: FastPaisa Instant 7-Day Micro Loan Sideload APK
payload.description: Predatory APK distributed via SMS links that exfiltrates contacts and photo gallery, followed by abusive extortion calls to family members.
payload.sampleTemplate: Approved Rs 50,000 instant loan in 2 minutes without CIBIL. Download APK now: {{url}}

payload.title: BharatLoan Easy Cash Malicious Harassment App
payload.description: Disburses only 60% of loan amount, charges 200% interest in 6 days, then circulates morphed photos to WhatsApp contact groups.
payload.sampleTemplate: लोन अप्रूव हो गया है! ₹75,000 तुरंत अपने बैंक में प्राप्त करें बिना किसी कागजात के: {{url}}

payload.title: QuickDhan Instant Andhra/Telangana Loan Distribution Site
payload.description: Phishing domain masquerading as an RBI-registered NBFC offering quick credit to college students and gig workers.
payload.sampleTemplate: సులభమైన రుణం ₹1,00,000 మీ ఖాతాలో 5 నిమిషాల్లో. ఇప్పుడే దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోండి: {{url}}

payload.title: Spoofed SBI NetBanking Reward Points Portal
payload.description: Harvests Internet Banking username, password, profile password, and intercepted 2FA OTPs pretending to convert points into cash.
payload.sampleTemplate: Dear SBI Customer, your reward points worth Rs 8,750 will expire tonight. Redeem cash into account now: {{url}}

payload.title: Fake State Electricity Disconnection Notice Link
payload.description: Urgent phishing SMS claiming electricity power supply will be cut off at 9:30 PM tonight due to unpaid bill; prompts installing remote access app.
payload.sampleTemplate: प्रिय ग्राहक, आपकी बिजली का बिल अपडेट नहीं हुआ है, आज रात 9:30 बजे बिजली काट दी जाएगी। बिल जमा करने के लिए संपर्क करें: {{url}}

payload.title: Fake HDFC NetBanking PAN-Aadhaar Mandate Portal
payload.description: Threatens account deactivation within 24 hours unless PAN card and NetBanking credentials are submitted immediately.
payload.sampleTemplate: Dear HDFC User, your account has been temporarily restricted due to non-updated PAN card. Update KYC to prevent freeze: {{url}}

payload.title: Spoofed EPFO Provident Fund Passbook Withdrawal Site
payload.description: Targets salaried employees claiming unclaimed provident fund bonus of Rs 42,000 waiting for immediate withdrawal.
payload.sampleTemplate: ईपीएफओ सूचना: आपके पीएफ खाते में ₹42,500 का क्लेम उपलब्ध है। तुरंत अपने खाते में ट्रांसफर करें: {{url}}

payload.title: Fake YouTube / Google Maps Hotel Review Task Scam
payload.description: Victims are paid Rs 150 for the first 3 reviews on Telegram, then coerced into "crypto VIP trading tasks" losing lakhs.
payload.sampleTemplate: Earn Rs 3,500 - 8,000 daily from home just by liking YouTube videos and rating Google maps hotels! Contact HR on Telegram: {{url}}

payload.title: Spoofed E-Commerce Product Rating Commission Site
payload.description: Pretends to be an Amazon affiliate rating merchant portal; lures homemakers with small returns before freezing balances.
payload.sampleTemplate: வீட்டிலிருந்தே அமேசான் பொருட்களை மதிப்பீடு செய்து தினமும் ரூ. 5000 சம்பாதிக்கலாம். விவரங்களுக்கு இங்கே கிளிக் செய்யவும்: {{url}}

payload.title: Fake OLX Indian Army Officer Buyer UPI Handle
payload.description: Scammer poses as transferred Army officer wanting to buy furniture; sends a "Collect Money / Pay" QR code claiming it is to receive funds.
payload.sampleTemplate: I am transferring token advance of Rs 15,000. Scan this QR code and enter UPI PIN to receive money into your GooglePay/PhonePe.

payload.title: Spoofed International Courier Customs Fee UPI VPA
payload.description: Used in tandem with romance/gift parcel scams where a fake foreign friend sends an expensive iPhone/jewelry parcel.
payload.sampleTemplate: Consignment parcel stuck at IGI Delhi Airport Customs. Deposit clearance fee of Rs 28,500 to VPA: {{url}}

payload.title: Spoofed MoRTH eChallan Traffic Violation Fine Portal
payload.description: Phishing domain cloned identically to Parivahan portal; sends fake speed camera violation SMS with malware download link.
payload.sampleTemplate: Challan #DL-2026-9812 has been issued against your vehicle. Pay Rs 1,000 fine within 24h to avoid court summons: {{url}}

payload.title: Fake Bengaluru Traffic Police 50% Fine Rebate Portal
payload.description: Capitalizes on periodic traffic police rebate announcements to harvest credit card and UPI credentials.
payload.sampleTemplate: BTP 50% discount on pending traffic fines valid for next 48 hours only! Check vehicle fines and pay online: {{url}}
